selection: Lowest validation finite Huber plus candidate soft-rank CE, equally averaging predeclared validation cohorts; no test checkpoint selection.
scope: Independent Q(S), Q(G); exact complete goals only; no oracle in inference features, no pruning, no search, no LLM retraining.
hypothesis: Fitting diagnostic after full replay-bank coverage failed to remove cycles. Both arms start at the identical completed 6000-update branch checkpoint, with fresh optimizer and sampling phase, same raw independent state encoding, exact labels, held queries, two losses and larger batches. Keep all 16384 broad point draws, append16384 replay points, and use75 percent of4096 ranking decisions for the frozen replay bank. Only seed versus complete-branch bank differs between arms. The purpose is to test whether prioritizing already-exposed cycle neighborhoods improves continuous execution before expanding data or declaring convergence; the changed quota and learning rate are a new fitting phase, not an exact continuation or acceptance claim.
